"""tallyd — in-memory metrics counter service."""

__version__ = "0.5.2"
"""tallyd.core — in-memory metric counter rollups."""

from collections import defaultdict


class Counters:
    """A tiny counter store with prefix rollups, used by the dashboards."""

    def __init__(self):
        self._counts = defaultdict(int)

    def incr(self, name, by=1):
        if by < 0:
            raise ValueError("increment must be non-negative")
        self._counts[name] += by
        return self._counts[name]

    def value(self, name):
        return self._counts[name]

    def rollup(self, prefix):
        """Sum every counter whose name starts with ``prefix``."""
        return sum(v for k, v in self._counts.items() if k.startswith(prefix))

    def snapshot(self):
        """Return a plain-dict copy of the current counters."""
        return dict(self._counts)
=== tests ===
import unittest

from tallyd.core import Counters


class CountersTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_incr_and_value(self):
        c = Counters()
        self.assertEqual(c.incr("http.200"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(c.incr("http.200", 4), 5)
        self.assertEqual(c.value("http.200"), 5)

    def test_rollup_by_prefix(self):
        c = Counters()
        c.incr("http.200", 3)
        c.incr("http.500", 2)
        c.incr("db.query", 7)
        self.assertEqual(c.rollup("http."), 5)

    def test_negative_rejected(self):
        c = Counters()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            c.incr("x", -1)

    def test_snapshot_is_copy(self):
        c = Counters()
        c.incr("a")
        snap = c.snapshot()
        snap["a"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(c.value("a"), 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
